panels.title: Registered instruments per day by record type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, record_type, count(*) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND ('__all' IN ($record_type) OR record_type IN ($record_type))
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('$search' = '' OR ticker ILIKE '$search%')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, record_type

panels.title: Upcoming expirations, next 30 days (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT expiration_date::VARCHAR AS expiration_date,
  asset,
  record_type,
  count(*) AS instruments,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'CALL') AS calls,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'PUTT') AS puts,
  min(strike_price)::DOUBLE AS min_strike,
  max(strike_price)::DOUBLE AS max_strike
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND expiration_date BETWEEN trad_dt AND trad_dt + INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND ('__all' IN ($record_type) OR record_type IN ($record_type))
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('$search' = '' OR ticker ILIKE '$search%')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY expiration_date, instruments DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Assets with most listed options (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT asset,
  count(*) AS options,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'CALL') AS calls,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'PUTT') AS puts,
  count(DISTINCT expiration_date) AS expirations
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND option_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY options DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: New listings: trading start in range (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT trading_start_date::VARCHAR AS trading_start_date,
  ticker,
  record_type,
  asset,
  description,
  isin,
  expiration_date::VARCHAR AS expiration_date,
  option_type,
  strike_price::DOUBLE AS strike_price
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND $__timeFilter(trading_start_date::TIMESTAMP)
  AND ('__all' IN ($record_type) OR record_type IN ($record_type))
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('$search' = '' OR ticker ILIKE '$search%')
ORDER BY trading_start_date DESC, ticker
LIMIT 1000

WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker,
  record_type,
  security_category,
  instrument_id,
  isin,
  asset,
  description,
  corporate_name,
  specification_code,
  governance,
  cfi_code,
  currency,
  expiration_date::VARCHAR AS expiration_date,
  option_type,
  option_style,
  strike_price::DOUBLE AS strike_price,
  underlying_instrument_id,
  contract_multiplier::DOUBLE AS contract_multiplier,
  round_lot,
  last_price::DOUBLE AS last_price,
  trading_start_date::VARCHAR AS trading_start_date,
  trading_end_date::VARCHAR AS trading_end_date
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND ('__all' IN ($record_type) OR record_type IN ($record_type))
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('$search' = '' OR ticker ILIKE '$search%')
ORDER BY ticker
LIMIT 1000
